specification:
Prudentia YouTube video-on-demand workload (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1).
1. Go to 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<secret>video_id</secret>&autoplay=1' (reference video: Big Buck Bunny).
2. Wait briefly for the player page to load and autoplay to start.
3. Keep the video playing for <secret>watch_seconds</secret> seconds (Prudentia runs 600 s and ignores the first/last 120 s).
